---
name: OOVS standard feedback
about: Comment on a requirement, acceptance test, schema, or mapping
labels: ["feedback", "needs-triage"]
---

## OOVS version and location

Version, requirement or test ID, file, and section.

## Comment type

Testability / correctness / evidence / safety-rights / legal-scope / interoperability / accessibility / editorial.

## Observation

What is unclear, incorrect, unsafe, hard to assess, or worth extending?

## Evidence and scope

Link stable primary sources where possible. State jurisdiction, population, domain, version, limitations, affiliation, and conflicts of interest.

## Suggested resolution

Suggest wording, a test, a schema change, or another disposition, and describe trade-offs.

## Publication-safety check

- [ ] No personal, victim, case, target, credential, classified, or operationally sensitive information is included.
- [ ] Any high-risk effect is described at the control or outcome level.
